content_descriptors.notes: This game contains fantasy violence, including melee combat with swords and shields against human-like knights and monstrous creatures. Blood effects are present upon enemy and player impact. Defeated enemies leave behind corpses. The game does not contain nudity, sexual content, drug or alcohol abuse, or themes of self-harm.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5.3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan-compatible graphics drivers. SSD Recommended
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5.3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan-compatible graphics drivers. SSD Recommended
